name: Interval Countdown Overlay UI
purpose: Compact circular countdown for the current structured-workout segment.

include: center time or distance value with elapsed or remaining direction
optional phase, rep, helper, and caption text
independent typography controls per text role
shared background, border, shadow, and glow behavior
excludeV1: separate interval color palette when project interval colors are available

dataSources.remainingTime: Current LapRecord end time minus current activity elapsed time.
dataSources.centerDistance: Current activity distance minus the current LapRecord start distance, clamped to the current lap total distance.
dataSources.progress: Current segment remaining fraction or elapsed fraction, selected by ring direction and clamped to 0...1.
dataSources.groupColors: Existing interval color settings for warmup, active/work, rest, cooldown, and unknown.

visibilityRules.centerValue: Always visible; no hide toggle. It can resolve time or distance in elapsed or remaining direction.
visibilityRules.caption: Hideable.
visibilityRules.layoutWhenHidden: Hidden optional roles do not reserve layout rows. Remaining visible content recenters in the inner circle while countdownTime stays dominant.

repRules.active: Current active lap ordinal among active laps.
repRules.rest: Most recent or next active rep context, consistent with Interval HUD Bar semantics.
repRules.warmupCooldown: No rep label unless implementation has a clear structured-workout rep context.

options.clockwise: Draw the remaining fraction clockwise from the top; starts Full and reaches Empty.
options.counterclockwise: Draw the elapsed fraction counterclockwise from the top; starts Empty and reaches Full.

layout.jitterPrevention: Use tabular or monospaced digits for centerValue.

fill.sourceWhenFollowing: Current LapRecord.kind resolved through interval group colors.

colorModeRules.followGroupColor: Use current interval group color resolved from LapRecord.kind.
colorModeRules.customColor: Use one fixed user-selected color for that text role.
colorModeRules.countdownTime: Supports both color modes but remains visible.

colors.source: Reuse Project Settings interval colors and helpers shared with Interval HUD Bar and Interval Timeline.

background.shape: circle or rounded square bounds matching the circular component; renderer should visually read as a circular dark backing.
background.paddingRule: Background padding expands background and border bounds only; it must not scale, move, or compress ring or text.
background.disabledBehavior: No synthetic card/backing is drawn; ring and text render as foreground parts over video.

shadow.targetWhenBackgroundDisabled: all visible internal parts: progress track, progress fill, countdownTime, helperLabel, phaseLabel, repLabel, caption

globalGlow.targetWhenBackgroundDisabled: all visible internal parts glow together, including text, progress track, and progress fill
globalGlow.targetWhenBackgroundEnabled: foreground content group inside the background
globalGlow.relationshipToRingLocalGlow: Global glow and Progress Ring Glow are separate effects. If both are enabled, progress fill receives both the group glow and the ring-local glow.

inspector.sectionOrderRequirement: The final three sections are Background, Border, Effects and must reuse shared inspector modules.

controls.text: Expose one group per typography role. Hideable-role visibility uses a mini switch in the trailing group header; rows use short Font, Size, Weight, Color, and Custom labels.
controls.effects: Shared OverlayEffectsInspectorModule. Shadow and global glow targets follow background-enabled rules in this spec.

rendering.progressClamping: Clamp the direction-resolved remaining or elapsed fraction to 0...1.
rendering.centerValueCompatibility: Projects and templates without center metric or value direction use Time and End to 0.
rendering.fallbackState: When there is no current lap, show 0:00 or --:-- based on existing interval overlay empty-state conventions, and use unknown group color.
rendering.animation: Countdown and progress ring update at Layer Data FPS.
rendering.accessibility: Inspector controls must label every icon-only color/follow toggle and expose current role names.

acceptanceCriteria: Center value is always visible and remains centered when every optional text role is hidden.
Center value supports time or distance with either End to 0 or 0 to End direction.
Each text role can independently change font family, size, weight, color mode, and custom color.
Each hideable text role can be hidden without reserving blank layout space.
Follow Group Color resolves text and progress fill colors from the current LapRecord.kind.
Progress Ring Glow affects only the progress fill.
With Background enabled and Shadow enabled, only the background surface casts a shadow.
With Background disabled and Shadow enabled, all visible internal parts cast shadow.
With Background disabled and shared/global Glow enabled, all visible internal parts glow together.
If ring-local glow and shared/global glow are both enabled, the progress fill receives both effects without changing layout.
Preview and export match for ring geometry, text placement, shadow target, and glow target.
